results.title: Sept. 16: Fed hikes rates as federal net interest tops $1 trillion
results.description: THE CENTER SQUARE — The Federal Reserve raised interest rates a quarter point Sept. 16, its first increase in three years, a unanimous move that came despite President Donald Trump's demands for cuts, with officials signaling more increases could follow...
